name: Iori
message: 「All right, it's time for some practice matches. First up are Setsugekka and Ririmu.」

name: Iori
message: 「—However, for this practice match, I'm going to put a little restriction on the two of you.」

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka, you have to stay calm and not go berserk. And Ririmu, you'll fight using only swordsmanship, without using your special Tenju.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Whaaat, no way！ That's my whole aesthetic！」

name: Iori
message: 「Nope. Whether it's going berserk or that Tenju, in a way, they're secret weapons for you two—your trump cards, so to speak.」

name: Iori
message: 「So it's important to build a solid foundation first, that way you can save them as a last resort.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yessir, roger that！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hmm, well, pulling out a trump card in a pinch for a dramatic comeback might not be half bad~」

name: Iori
message: 「Glad to hear you're on board.」

name: Iori
message: 「Now then, make sure you fight under those restrictions. Break them, and not only is it an automatic loss, I'll confiscate your pudding snack too！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「No way！」

name: Asahi
message: 「...Did we even have snacks？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「No, we don't, but I still don't want my pudding confiscated~！」
Setsugekka and Ririmu face off in the center of the training ground, brimming with motivation.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Anyway, I just have to knock you flat without going berserk, right? Easy, super easy~!」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I wonder if you can pull that off, Secchan？ Aren't you gonna go berserk and still end up getting knocked flat？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whaaat was that?！」
Grinning boldly at each other, trading barbs as if just chatting—

name: Iori
message: 「Are you two ready？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「All right—whenever you're ready, Sensei.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I'm ready too—we can start anytime.」
The moment they draw their Origami, both of their expressions change in an instant.
Even if they were just chatting moments ago, when it comes to fighting they're dead serious—they really are swordswomen, after all.

name: Iori
message: 「Now then... begin！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Here I come, Ririmu-chan！」
Almost the very instant the signal is given, it's Setsugekka who springs forward—

name: Setsugekka
message: （Strike first, win the day！ Dive in all at once and take her down in one go！）
If I can't go berserk, then I just need to take her down so fast that I don't even have time to.
I push off the ground with all my might and charge toward Ririmu！

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hraaaaaah！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Whoa... that was close！」
After a side-swinging strike, I step in further for a backhand follow-up. But she dodged it.
Ririmu looks surprised as she hops backward like a rabbit—
I chase after her instantly！

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Gotcha！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Watch it！」
This time, Ririmu swings her Origami while retreating, lightly scraping my Barrier Jacket.
Still, this much is nothing. I'll keep pushing, keep attacking！

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That's barely anything, keep going！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「And you're not catching me with that either~！」
I aim for the right, anticipating she’ll dodge right, but she goes left. I aim for the left, and she goes right—
Even at a distance where I think I’ve got her, Ririmu slips through my reach with nimble steps.
Before I know it, she’s swinging her Origami from out of my reach.
The attacks are so shallow I wouldn't even need my Barrier Jacket, yet she manages to land them every time I attack！

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ugh, I'm the one on the offense here！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「But you’re not landing a single hit！」
The only one landing hits, as usual, is Ririmu...！
Dammit！ Why is this happening when I'm the one putting on the pressure?！

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hyaaaaaaah！」
I use a bare-handed strike as a feint and swing my Origami in a hurry before she can escape.
But Ririmu blocks it—
Or rather, she looks so composed that it feels like she stopped instead of running away on purpose...！

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ahaha, are you just charging ahead blindly now？ Have you gone berserk already~？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「No way!? I'm totally fine!」

name: Ririmu
message: 「You've got a pretty scary look on your face, though！」
I pull back the blocked Origami and immediately target Ririmu's torso from a different angle.
But by then, Ririmu had already moved away. And my Barrier Jacket got scraped again for good measure！

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Stop running away like that...！」
Each hit is only minor, but I can feel them stacking up because she keeps landing them.
I can't land a hit, she keeps running away, she keeps poking at me. All of it is just so frustrating I can't stand it.
And that irritation swirls up, turning my mind pitch black—

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka！ No going berserk！ Calm down！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ngh！ S-Sensei...！」

name: Iori
message: 「For an in-fighter, chasing down a fleeing opponent is an everyday occurrence. What good does getting irritated over it do！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Only giving advice to Secchan is so unfair~！ Say something to me too！」

name: Iori
message: 「Keep it up, Ririmu, try even harder！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Isn't that kinda half-assed？！」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, things are going so smoothly right now that there's nothing to critique.」
While Sensei and Ririmu―chan are talking, I calm myself down―that's right, I have to stay calm！
My opponent hates close combat, so she runs away. She tries to keep a distance that favors her. That's only natural.

name: Setsugekka
message: （But looking at it the other way, she's running away because it'd be bad for her if I got close...！）
In other words, this is the right move. I just have to close in with everything I've got. If she runs away, I just have to get so close she can't escape！

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Here I come, Ririmu-chan！」
I kick off the ground hard once again and charge forward at full speed.
Charging headlong like a boar？ Like hell I'll settle for just a boar！

name: Ririmu
message: 「There you go again！」

name: Setsugekka
message: （This is my way of fighting！）

name: Iori
message: 「...Setsugekka's movements changed a little.」
I watch Setsugekka fiercely pressing in on Ririmu, impressed.
Meanwhile, Asahi and Momiji beside me look on with half-lidded eyes and mutter in exasperation.

name: Asahi
message: 「Well, certainly... she's charging ahead even harder than before.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Dunno if I'd call that changing, though.」

name: Iori
message: 「No, she has changed. Setsugekka is keeping her cool.」
While following Setsugekka with my eyes as she parries Ririmu's diagonal slash and dashes even further forward.

name: Iori
message: 「Up until a moment ago, she was just repeating the same cycle: charge in and attack, get dodged and countered, then charge in again once Ririmu backed off.」

name: Iori
message: 「But now, she's deliberately letting Ririmu strike first, blocking it, and then stepping even further into the space Ririmu retreats toward.」

name: Iori
message: 「That's why her forward momentum looks even stronger than before. And thanks to that—」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Gotcha！」

name: Asahi
message: 「It hit...！」
Setsugekka's attack finally grazed Ririmu just as she was pulling back.
That in itself probably didn't deal much damage. Yet—it carries far more meaning than that.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Darn it...！ I wanted a total shutout！」
With Setsugekka having regained her composure, Ririmu is finding it harder to keep getting away.

name: Iori
message: （If she loses control, it won't go like this. I wonder if she realizes how important this calmness is）
In fact, Setsugekka seems to have gotten a feel for it, showing a smug expression that contrasts sharply with earlier.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hehehe~. Ririmu-chan, you've just been running away, haven't you？ It feels like I'm chasing after a mouse.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Nah, it's just that before I can even get close, Secchan starts sending out such passionate love calls.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I feel bad for you, Secchan, but I'm not into that sort of thing~♪」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I'm not into that either！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ahaha！ Well, I guess so... Besides, just running away all the time isn't really my style, you know？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Think it's time I gave you a little skinship from my end！」
In a sudden turn, Ririmu makes her move—！

name: Ririmu
message: 「Here I come, Secchan！」
Ririmu begins unleashing attacks mixed with feints, utilizing a unique, zigzagging step.
Right when it looks like she's going right, she comes from the left; from the left, she comes from below.
Setsugekka seems bewildered by the blades launched from such an unusual tempo and stance.
Furthermore, Ririmu is taking advantage of the difference in reach to strike from outside Setsugekka's range.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Swordsmanship is all about how you swing that Origami, isn't it~！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I have an Origami too, you know！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Gyah！」
Setsugekka swings her reverse-gripped Origami like a hook, but it's easily dodged and she takes a counterattack.
Her reverse grip is a result of her focus on unarmed combat, but attacks with the Origami are a step too slow, and the disadvantage in reach remains.
Because of this, when a skilled swordswoman like Ririmu goes on the offensive, she is inevitably forced into a disadvantageous defensive battle.
That is Setsugekka's struggle, but as long as she fights with martial arts, it is a wall she must absolutely overcome.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Come on, come on！ I'm gonna finish this all at once~！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Dammit！」
Setsugekka catches Ririmu's downward strike by crossing her arms and blocking it with her gauntlets, like a shirahadori blade catch.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Whoa, that's way too reckless...！」
Of course, normally you wouldn't be able to counter after catching a blow like that, but—

name: Setsugekka
message: 「……Mishima-ryuu Type Kou, Edanagi！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Kyaauhh！？」
Not with her arms, but with her leg this time. She kicks Ririmu’s body away while spinning！

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ow-ow-ow…… Seriously, Secchan, you’re absolutely brutal.」
Managing to correct her posture without falling, she rubs her stomach where she was kicked.
Even with her Barrier Jacket active, the impact is ridiculous. If she were flesh and blood, her organs might have been in trouble.

name: Ririmu
message: （Honestly, I might’ve underestimated her a bit……）
She watches Secchan while getting back into her stance.

name: Ririmu
message: （I thought there was no way she could win fighting an Origami barehanded, but she’s actually pretty capable, huh……）

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Come on, we’re just getting started！」
Secchan dives in. She’s many times faster than a normal person; she’s not a boar, she’s like a bullet—！

name: Ririmu
message: 「I’d really prefer it if you’d slow down！」
Her attacks are incredibly fast, too. No matter how many she dodges, Secchan’s body immediately follows up with the next strike.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I’m not letting you get away！」
Secchan’s fist whistles past Ririmu's side. It was so fast and sharp she could feel the wind from it alone—

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Next up is this…… Mishima-ryuu Type Tsuchinoe, Houda Chouchuu！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Aghh……！！」
The fist that had passed by turned into an elbow strike and flew right into her side……！

name: Ririmu
message: （It’s moves like this that are a real pain！）
That elbow just now, and that kick from before. Unexpected attacks keep coming from unexpected angles.
On top of that, Ririmu's own attacks get blocked by her gauntlets like before.
She’s essentially a walking weapon and a walking suit of armor all in one. If she didn't have an Origami, Secchan might seriously be the strongest.

name: Ririmu
message: 「……Well, since I’ve got my Origami, I’m still stronger！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Gyan！」
Secchan’s attacks are definitely fast, and sometimes they don’t even make sense, but her reach is short after all, so I have the definitive advantage！
Thanks to that, for every three hits I land, I only take one from her.
In that case, if I just press the attack like this, I win—！

name: Ririmu
message: 「Here I come！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hmph……！」
Ririmu steps forward to launch an attack. At that moment—she felt like Secchan’s eyes flashed.

name: Ririmu
message: （Uh-oh, this might be bad...！！）

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Mishima-ryuu Type Tsuchinoto—Chibashiri！！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Kyaaaaaaaah！」
Taking Setsugekka's strike dead―on, Ririmu is sent flying back―
The instant Ririmu launched her attack. Without even taking a defensive stance, Setsugekka had suddenly halted as if glued to the ground, driving in a counterattack fully willing to trade blows.
Let them cut your flesh to sever their bone, I suppose.

name: Ririmu
message: 「O-Ow... Seriously, you're pretty good, huh？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whoa, I was totally sure that took you out！ You can still get back up.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Well, I hadn't really taken much damage up 'til now, y'know... My VF value only dropped a tiny bit, right？」
In reality, that last hit shaved off quite a chunk, and even if she's putting on a brave front, Ririmu surely knows it too.
The damage must really be taking its toll, as her face is twisted in pain.

name: Iori
message: 「Ririmu, don't get cocky just because you have the upper hand. Setsugekka's martial arts have plenty of techniques meant for dealing with swordsmen.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Yeah, yeah, I know already~！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Heh-heh-heh, I'm gonna push right through and take this！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Didn't you hear that advice about not getting cocky？ Get too full of yourself and the tables'll turn on you in a flash, y'know？」
Ririmu readies her Origami once more—and leaps forward.

name: Ririmu
message: 「'Cause after all, I'm about to get a little serious！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ngh...！ Take this！」
Blocking Ririmu's barrage of strikes, Setsugekka launches a counterattack.
However, Ririmu deflects it with a spinning motion and uses that momentum to press her assault even further.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Come on, come on！ Right there！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Then how about this... Mishima-ryuu Type Hinoe—Ugachibi！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Huh！？」
It looked like Setsugekka had tried to land a counterattack just like before.
Yet that too is effortlessly parried aside, leaving her doing nothing more than exposing her defenseless body.

name: Ririmu
message: 「I'm not gonna let you hit me anymore~！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Kyauuu！」
From the right, from the left, and even from above and below, Ririmu rains down a flurry of strikes from all directions as if dancing.
Unable to keep up with her rhythm, Setsugekka is simply toyed with, her occasional counterattacks slicing vainly through empty air—

name: Ririmu
message: 「This oughta finish it！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Nghaaaaa...！」
A powerful blow landed square on her as she staggered, and Setsugekka finally collapsed to her knees.

name: Iori
message: 「Match over！ That’s enough！」
I saw that Setsugekka’s Barrier Jacket had been completely depleted, so I declared the end of the match.
Setsugekka braced her hands on the ground and hung her head in frustration.

name: Iori
message: 「Ririmu wins this one.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Heh-he-heh. Well, that was a piece of cake！」

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka, you alright？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ugh... I’m fine, but it’s so frustrating. I really thought I could’ve kept going...」

name: Iori
message: 「Staying calm until the very end was great work. Ririmu’s skills were just a cut above today.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That’s exactly why it’s so frustrating！」
Well, there’s no helping that, and it’s a good thing to feel frustrated.

name: Iori
message: 「In fact, Ririmu’s swordsmanship sense is quite high. She’s able to fight this well even without her special Tenju.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「See? I’m full of potential when I put my mind to it~」

name: Iori
message: 「If you keep refining it like this, Ririmu, you’re really going to be a powerhouse.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Teach, you’re really laying on the compliments today, aren’t ya?♪」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Oh, right！ Let me spar with Momichi next！」

name: Iori
message: 「No, I was planning on having Momiji spar with Asahi. Besides, don’t you have some damage from this round？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「A little bit like this is nothing！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Besides, I’m in the zone right now. Like, this is the perfect chance to beat Momichi up, ya know？」

name: Iori
message: 「Hmm... I don’t know about that. I’m sure Asahi wanted her turn to spar, too.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I don’t mind. I’ll let Ririmu have my spot.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「For real！？ C’mon, Teach！ Asahi says it’s fine！」

name: Iori
message: 「Are you sure, Asahi？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes. Watching the current match made me feel that I need a bit more objective observation.」

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, if that’s what you say, then let’s do it. Ririmu, you’re staying in！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Yay！ Asahi does something nice once in a while, huh. Is this what they call even a demoness shedding a tear？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Fufufufu...」
...No telling what she's plotting.

name: Momiji
message: 「Oh, well then maybe I should let Setsugekka have a turn~. You know, I kinda want to do some observing and stuff.」

name: Iori
message: 「No.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ehh, whyyy！ Discrimination is bad, you know~」

name: Iori
message: 「You just want to slack off, don't you, Momiji？」

name: Iori
message: 「Then, let's start the match between Ririmu and Momiji.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Fufu. I'm on a roll right now. Even though it's you, Momitchi, don't you go letting your guard down, okay？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Didn't you just say earlier that if you get carried away, you'll get turned around in an instant？」
While bickering, the two take their stances and face off.
We take Setsugekka and step away from the scene—

name: Iori
message: 「The conditions are the same as before. Ririmu, no special Tenju, swordplay only.」

name: Iori
message: 「Now then... begin！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Here I come！」

name: Momiji
message: 「...Understood.」
At the signal, this time it is Ririmu who takes the initiative, the opposite of the previous match.
That said, of course she isn't charging straight in; she's using the same eccentric footwork she showed in her fight with Setsugekka.
With a hopping, dancing-like rhythm and feints, she closes the distance to strike at Momiji, who stands still in her stance.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Take this, and this！」
She keeps her sword tip hidden behind her body, making the origin of her attacks difficult to read.
Combined with Ririmu's peculiar movements, even watching from the side is enough to get someone disoriented.
Even so, Momiji manages to parry them, but—

name: Ririmu
message: 「Still not enough, how about this！」
Momiji is forced to retreat by an attack aimed at her feet. She blocks and deflects the attacks from the pursuing Ririmu, then retreats further.
The scene looks just like Ririmu did when she faced Setsugekka.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Are you copying me？ Too bad for you, that won't work on me~！」
In reality, Ririmu's attacks are extremely difficult to dodge.
To counterattack, one would have to use a method like Setsugekka's—sacrificing one's own flesh to break the opponent's bones.
Ririmu knows this too, and by refusing to give Momiji a clear target, she keeps changing up her tactics, attacking Momiji with every conceivable trajectory.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Come on, how about something like this！」
Perhaps unable to fend off that unique assault any longer, Ririmu's blade tip begins to catch Momiji.
However—though Momiji’s face twisted slightly, she didn't shift to a counterattack, silently taking it instead.

name: Iori
message: 「...Momiji, what’s wrong？ You’re not trying to attack.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Maybe there’s no opening？ Even for Momimomi, taking that head-on seems tough.」

name: Iori
message: 「True, it doesn't look like it could be handled with standard reads, but...」
In other words, does this mean even with Momiji’s power, she hasn’t found a way to deal with it yet—？

name: Ririmu
message: 「Moo... Hey, Momitchi！ It’s felt totally one-sided since a while ago, you know？」
She isn't attacking back at all, and it’s somehow unsettling, so I pause for a moment—is this what they call ‘testing the waters’？

name: Ririmu
message: 「Are you perhaps, holding back？」

name: Momiji
message: 「No, that is not the case at all.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Whoa, you’ve got such a calm look on your face！ Creepy.」
...But then again, no matter what Momitchi does, it’s not like I’m going to change, right？

name: Ririmu
message: 「I’m just going to stick to my own worldview, that’s all.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I see. Please, show me more.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Well then, I guess I’ll grant your request！」
I charge at Momitchi, who still isn't moving！
And this time, I’ll set the rhythm so she can’t dodge it—！

name: Ririmu
message: 「Gotcha！！」
Avoiding her guard, I land a direct hit to her stomach！ A solid impact！
Well, I didn't manage to take her down, but the fact that Momitchi jumped back in a panic means it definitely did some damage.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Heh, hmph. Momitchi, are you actually not all that much？ Or is the current me just too strong？」
I try provoking her.
But Momitchi still isn't biting, and there’s still no sign of her counterattacking.
Wait a minute, I’ve been hearing something for a while now...

name: Momiji
message: 「Hmm, hmmm-hmm...♪」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Humming？ Momitchi, surely you aren't trying to make a fool out of me...」
Making a fool of me—that’s what I thought, but no. This is...！

name: Momiji
message: 「Fufufun, hmm, hmm...♪ Fufufun...♪」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Eh, wait... seriously？ Momitchi, that is...」
A chill runs down my spine.
I know this hummed tune. Of course I know it.
I mean—nobody except me is supposed to know it！
I could clearly see Ririmu's shock and agitation.

name: Momiji
message: （Well, I guess that's only natural—it's probably something she really doesn't want found out, after all）
I had been thinking about it the whole time. Ririmu's unique footwork, her attacks—whether there was some kind of pattern behind that strange rhythm.

name: Momiji
message: （It's not completely at random. I know that much. No human is capable of that）
Then what was the basis of that pattern? Counting her steps, observing the movement of her feet, tracing the flow of her gaze...
And just now, I finally figured it out.
It was that humming—music.
In Ririmu's head, there must always be some kind of music playing.
The steps she beats out, the sword strikes riding that rhythm—all of it follows that music.

name: Momiji
message: （Though because it's packed with Ririmu's own personal arrangements, it took me quite a while to decipher）
Still, I've roughly "understood" the pattern now. It might not be everything, but this is enough.

name: Momiji
message: 「Now then... shall we finish this?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「...Yeah right. We're only just getting started！」
Shaking off her agitation, she raises her stance.
Even so, it's already over.

name: Momiji
message: （...Shingan no Kiwamete, engage）
At that moment—with timing that seemed utterly abrupt, Momiji made her move.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Tch, why you—！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Kyaaah！？」
Ririmu's uniquely stepped attacks, defenses, evasions—as if seeing completely through them all, Momiji cuts her off and lands a fierce blow.

name: Ririmu
message: 「You little... You're suddenly going way too hard！」
Ririmu immediately regains her stance and shifts to a counterattack.
Moreover, her movements are different from before, as if she's changed the tempo.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Not yet—over here！」
Not only faking her motions, she mixes in feints that even shift the timing of her lunges, unleashing a unique flurry of strikes at the pursuing Momiji—

name: Ririmu
message: 「Right there！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Too bad, that's not it.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「No way！？ You're reading all of this too！？」
Ririmu's counterattack—Momiji parried every single strike to perfection.
And with that, next up—

name: Momiji
message: 「Now then, it's my turn！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Aghhh！」
Once the situation flipped and Momiji went on the offensive, Ririmu couldn't even manage a proper defense.
Or rather, it was as if every move and dodge she made was being read, and she was being countered at every turn.
And after that barrage—

name: Momiji
message: 「This is the end！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Kyaaaaaa！」
Finally, dealt a powerful blow, Ririmu dropped to her knees on the spot.

name: Iori
message: 「That’s it！ Momiji wins.」

name: Momiji
message: 「...Haa~, all done, all done~」
As soon as I signaled the end of the match, Momiji immediately slumped, her strength leaving her.

name: Iori
message: 「You looked so cool during the match, but you’re back to normal the second it’s over.」
I couldn't help but let out a wry smile.

name: Momiji
message: 「When we draw our Origami and face off, it’s sword against sword. Since it’s a serious fight, showing the utmost respect is only natural.」

name: Momiji
message: 「But there’s no benefit in staying all stiff and formal all the time, is there?」
Well, I guess she’s just balancing things out in her own way.

name: Iori
message: 「More importantly, Ririmu, are you okay？」
When I helped her up, Ririmu looked up with a frustrated expression.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ah, man, I got totally wrecked！ I thought I had a chance at the start, too！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Pfft, that’s exactly what happened to me earlier！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I don’t appreciate being laughed at by Secchan, but hey, I was the one who beat you, right！？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Heh, why don’t we howl like loser dogs together?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「No way~, being lumped in with Secchan is an insult！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That remark is an insult to me in the first place!」

name: Asahi
message: 「You two are quite alike.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Haa... dammit, Suzakuin really is strong. Especially that last bit—it was crazy！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「But that was amazing. I want to know how you did it~」
Despite her frustration, Ririmu moved closer to Momiji.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hey, how come you were able to read my attacks？ What’s the trick behind that？ Tell me！」

name: Momiji
message: 「N-no, I’m not telling you... everyone will find out!」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Eh？ Then forget it. Hey, Teach, tell us！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Wait, you’re asking him！？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Come on, Teach, it’s fine, right~？ You said we were all gonna share, rememberrr！」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, of course it’s fine.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hey！ Stop it, will you！？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ah, then I want to know too！」

name: Asahi
message: 「May I ask as well？ I’ve started to get a handle on Ririmu-san’s side of things, but I haven’t been able to quite grasp Momiji-san’s.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I said noooo！！」
An annoyed Momiji cuts in, trying to shoo everyone away. Meanwhile, the others dodge her attempts, determined to hear what I have to say.
And I watch the whole scene unfold, feeling strangely amused by it all—
